messages:
Maya (AE): quick ask — Nimbus Health wants a hosted API pilot (embeddings-heavy). They expect ~5B embed tokens over 3 months. They're requesting a temporary per-token price of $0.0005 and to waive the min-charge for first 60 days. No commits, just POC. Can we entertain?
Liam (SE): can you add expected monthly token distribution? is this all embeddings? which model family?
Maya (AE): mostly embeddings with occasional reranking (~95% embeds). Model: rwd-embed-1-large. Monthly estimate: month1 2.2B, month2 1.8B, month3 1.0B. No data residency ask. Link: https://drive.google.com/nimbus-poc (internal)
Olivia (RevOps): @Maya thanks. From RevOps POV default hosted rate for rwd-embed-1-large is $0.0006/token and min monthly charge is $1,000. Waiving min is unusual. Need margin calc. Sam?
Sam (Finance): finance here — at $0.0005 we'd be ~17% below list. rough margin still okay if we attach controls. Waiving min hurts revenue and churn protection. Propose: instead of full waive, offer a $2,000 credit applied to first 60 days + temporary per-token $0.00055 for 60 days. After that revert to list or negotiate commit.
Ava (Sales Engineering): from SE: we can reduce effective tokens via batching + prefix cache. Also recommend setting request caps and a rate-limit header. Technical risk low.
Maya (AE): customer pushing — they want lower per-token and no min. What's the minimum approval path to make them move forward this week?
Olivia (RevOps): Deal Desk required. Need AE to submit deal form + forecast (monthly token table) and expected ARR if they convert. Legal will need to sign a short trial addendum. If submission is complete I can fast-track review.
Liam (SE): also flag for ops: rwd-embed-1-large on hosted can face capacity constraints during spikes. Recommend a soft fallback to rwd-embed-1-small or a queuing policy if latency spikes. Ops will need to sign off on routing.
redwood-dealbot: Deal desk review requested by @Maya. Submit here: https://redwood.internal/deals/submit (automated)
Maya (AE): submitted deal form — included usage table, competitor rates, conversion assumptions, and a short ROI calc.
Sam (Finance): after reviewing the submission: approved in principle with conditions:
- 60-day trial window with a $2,000 credit applied to the first invoice
- Temporary per-token rate $0.00055 for 60 days
- Min monthly charge resumes after trial period
- Customer must provide PO and sign the trial addendum (legal)
- Implement a 50% token cap guard and billing alerts; RevOps will suspend if exceeded
If Nimbus agrees to these, finance + RevOps will enable the override.
Ava (Sales Engineering): :thumbsup: I'll draft the SE checklist (rate-limiting headers, caching guidance, fallback model config) and the sample config snippet to add to the onboarding doc.
Olivia (RevOps): I'll create the temporary pricing override in the system once Legal confirms addendum is signed. Targeting to turn on within 24h of signatures.
Maya (AE): I'll present to Nimbus: offer is $0.00055/token, $2k credit for first 60 days, 60-day trial, 50% token cap + trial addendum. Will push for PO and signature today. Thanks everyone.
